outline: In this course, the basic concepts and applications of Nonlinear Programming Models in Operations Research. It includes Integer Programming、Dynamic Programming、Game Theory、Markovian Chains、Queueing Theory、Inventory Theory、Project Management and Simulation Modeling﹒
schedule:
Week 1~4. Network Optimization Models, Project Management
Week 5~8. Integer Programming
Week 9 Midterm
Week 10~12. Dynamic Programming
Week 13~14. Game Theory
Week 15~17. Decision Analysis
Week 18 Final Exam
scorePolicy:
Attendance: 10%
Quizes: 40%
Mid-term Exams: 25%
Final Exam: 25%.
materials: Hillier, F.S. and Lieberman, G.J. (2021), Introduction to Operations Research, 11th Edition, McGraw-Hill Int’l, Taipei. (required)
